title: What’s mind-blowing is that most of us came to the conclusion that there’s a city in the astral, while being completely unaware that multiple religions mention one existing.

classification.theory_summary: Claims many people have lucid dreams visiting unfamiliar places (malls, universities, water parks, casinos), connect online and report visiting the same locations; links this to an 'astral city' concept and cites religious references (New Jerusalem, Devapura).
classification.skip_reason: No single dream episode is described (no specific scenes, sequences, locations-within-a-dream, connections, or events). The post is primarily a general claim/theory about shared lucid-dream locations and religious parallels.

meta.author_theory: Many people have lucid dreams of unfamiliar but consistent shared locations (malls/universities/water parks/casinos), implying an 'astral city'; religions also describe astral cities (e.g., New Jerusalem; Devapura).

extraction.extraction_notes: Only generalized place-types are mentioned (malls, universities, water parks, casinos) without any concrete dream-instance details (no specific layout, sensory qualities, sequence, or events). Religious-city dimensions are included as cited description (New Jerusalem: 1,200 miles long/wide/high; floating above Earth) but are presented as doctrinal reference rather than a dream phenomenology report.
